formulas.name: bdrScriptIntro
formulas.expression: "Hi, this is " & {!$User.FirstName} & " " & {!$User.LastName} & " with EverQuote on a recorded line. I was calling to see if "& IF(ISBLANK({!Get_Contact_Record.Name}), {!get_Voice_Call_Record.Lead__r.FirstName} &" " &{!get_Voice_Call_Record.Lead__r.LastName}, {!Get_Contact_Record.Name}) &" or perhaps your office manager, might be available?"

formulas.name: IrsHandOffQuote
formulas.expression: "\"Hi (ISR), I have " & {!Get_Contact_Record.Name} & " on the phone and they are interested in hearing more about " & {!What_lead_types_are_you_interested_in1} & " products and services. They have " & {!How_many_sales_producers_do_you_currently_have_working1} & " number of producers. They are licensed in " & {!What_states_are_you_currently_licensed_to_write_in2} & " and are open to taking leads/transfers in the entire state. Are you ready for the transfer?\""

formulas.name: ISRIntroQuote
formulas.expression: "\"Hey " & {!Get_Contact_Record.Name} & ", I have (ISR) on the line. They will be able to help you with any of your questions from this point. Don't forget to ask them about our Lead Connection Service or Consumer Initiated Calls, as those products might be great for you! Take care.\""

formulas.description: Return the Contact Carrier if contact is not null, return the Lead Carrier if Contact is null and Lead is not converted, else return null
formulas.name: LeadorContactCarrier
screen2v2Quote
formulas.expression: "\"Hi, this is " & {!$User.FirstName} & " " & {!$User.LastName} & " on a recorded line with EverQuote. We are the leading business growth partner in the insurance space and offer a variety of products that can help you reach your agency goals including data leads, calls, and telemarketing services. I wanted to check in with you to see if we could help with your business planning– are you currently using leads, transfers, or other marketing strategies at your agency?\""

formulas.name: screen2VMQuote
formulas.expression: "\"Hi, this is " & {!$User.FirstName} & " " & {!$User.LastName} & " with EverQuote. We are the leading business growth partner in the insurance space and offer a variety of products that can help you reach your agency goals including data leads, calls, and telemarketing services. I wanted to check in with you to see if we could help with your business planning. If you’d like further information on what we are offering to help agents write more business you can reach me at " & {!$User.Phone} & " or book some time with me on the email I’ve just sent over– Have a good day!\""

fields.name: ReturnsPolicy
fields.fieldText:
"Everquote’s return policy allows for you to return up to 20% of your leads each calendar month, no questions asked. We use an automated system so as long as you are below the 20% threshold, all your returns will be accepted.


You also have 30 days after the initial purchase of a lead to submit it for return."

fields.name: Objection1
fields.fieldText:
"EverQuote is a lead vendor that specializes in generating our own, high-intent leads. 

﻿

Our leads are sourced through consumers conducting an online search for insurance quotes. We display an ad that speaks to their search language then they land on our site or one of our partner sites. They are then required to fill out up to 42 points of information for an auto or home quote. Their info is then sent directly to your CRM or LMS in real-time."

fields.name: Objection2
fields.fieldText:
"We have some great products that can help with staffing issues, especially our Lead Connection Service or LCS. LCS is a telemarketing subscription where you buy data leads and our expert team works the leads on your behalf. When we connect with consumers we then transfer them to your office and provide a warm hand off. 


This service helps increase efficiency and saves time enabling you to work up to 3X more leads. It also helps you make the most of existing producers and reduce the need to hire additional staff. Would you be interested in learning more about our LCS program today?"

fields.name: Objection3
fields.fieldText:
"I definitely understand that working leads can be a challenge. What are some of the issues you’ve faced with leads in the past? 


Our leads are some of the highest intent on the market, which translates to higher conversion rates. We also offer calls which can be a great alternative or supplement to data leads"

fields.name: Objection4
fields.fieldText: "Hey I know you have worked with us before, but we are constantly working to improve our products and traffic sources to provide the most high intent consumers. Along with leads, we also offer consumer initiated calls and our lead connection service, both of which help you connect with more consumers than traditional data leads. Would you like to learn more about those products?"

fields.name: Objection5
fields.fieldText: "What would you like for me to include? Just a heads up- our pricing is tailored based on your agency needs and structure. I’d love to connect with you once you’ve had a chance to review the email. When would be a good date and time for a follow up?"

fields.name: Objection6
fields.fieldText: "Where are you currently allocating your marketing budget? Leads are a great way to hit your growth goals and expand your business. Would you be willing to speak with one of our sales reps to explore where we might be able to improve your ROI?"

fields.name: SFScorecard
fields.fieldText: "Are you familiar with State Farm’s lead vendor scorecard? According to their data we are the highest converting lead vendor on the market and we are constantly reviewing and updating our quality and traffic to maintain that performance for State Farm agents."
